verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own background automations: AI-powered invoice entry, approval and payments, automated GL coding by entity, automated receipts, and auto-enforced budget controls. These run without manual steps. The evidence does not show a first-party builder for user-defined autonomous automations. Recurring workflows such as monthly exports or monthly-resetting cards rely on third-party Zapier/Pipedream integrations, which earn no credit. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/rule builder, documented scheduling or triggers for custom background jobs, details on autonomy and monitoring, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
